QUICK MEMORY REVISION
Recall the essential ideas

Gateway vs processor vs acquirer vs issuer
Issuer issues; acquirer acquires.

Authorization vs capture vs settlement
Approve → collect → settle.

Hosted checkout vs embedded vs direct API
Redirect, don't collect.

3-D Secure and customer authentication
Authenticate first, verify payment
separately.

Tokenization and saved payment methods
Token is a reference.

Merchant order vs payment attempt data model
One order, many attempts.

Atomic status transition and outbox
State + job, same commit.

Out-of-order webhooks and state guards
Arrival time ≠ event order.

Webhook acknowledgment, retries and dead-letter
queues
Accept durably, process reliably.

API keys, secret rotation and environment separation
Keys belong on the backend.

Return URL safety and order ownership
Return is read-only; ownership matters.

Partial payments, partial captures and overpayment
Paid total vs amount due.

Refund limits, fees and settlement accounting
Gross - adjustments = net.

Payment fraud signals and rate limiting
Limit attempts, review risk.

Payment testing matrix and sandbox simulation
Test the money, test the failures.

Payment monitoring and incident response
Detect → contain → reconcile.

Go-live checklist and operational handover
Test → approve → monitor.
